project.description: This job will generate all files needed to build the global allconcepts for all studies with a subject multi

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail
# Simple AWS S3 optimizations (keeps aws s3 cp) # - Prefer many small concurrent S3 requests (helps on high-latency links) # - Use adaptive retry mode for transient throttling # - Bump timeouts so long transfers don’t fail mid-stream # - (Optional) limit bandwidth if you’re saturating the host/network export AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS="${AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS:-10}" export AWS_RETRY_MODE="${AWS_RETRY_MODE:-adaptive}" export AWS_S3_MAX_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS="${AWS_S3_MAX_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS:-64}" export AWS_S3_MAX_QUEUE_SIZE="${AWS_S3_MAX_QUEUE_SIZE:-10000}" export AWS_S3_MULTIPART_THRESHOLD="${AWS_S3_MULTIPART_THRESHOLD:-64MB}" export AWS_S3_MULTIPART_CHUNKSIZE="${AWS_S3_MULTIPART_CHUNKSIZE:-64MB}" export AWS_CLI_CONNECT_TIMEOUT="${AWS_CLI_CONNECT_TIMEOUT:-10}" export AWS_CLI_READ_TIMEOUT="${AWS_CLI_READ_TIMEOUT:-0}" # 0 = no read timeout
LOG_TS() { date +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z"; } log() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] INFO $*" >&2; } warn() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] WARN $*" >&2; } error() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] ERROR $*" >&2; }
need() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { error "Missing required command: $1"; exit 2; }; }
cleanup() { local rc=$? local cmd="${BASH_COMMAND:-}" local line="${BASH_LINENO[0]:-}"
if [[ $rc -eq 0 ]]; then log "EXIT rc=0 (success). Cleaning AWS env vars." else error "EXIT rc=${rc} at line=${line} cmd=${cmd}. Cleaning AWS env vars." fi
unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
if [[ -s logs/error_logging.txt ]]; then warn "logs/error_logging.txt present (last 50 lines):" tail -n 50 logs/error_logging.txt >&2 || true fi } on_err() { local rc=$? local line="${BASH_LINENO[0]:-}" local cmd="${BASH_COMMAND:-}" error "ERR rc=${rc} at line=${line} cmd=${cmd}" return $rc } trap on_err ERR trap cleanup EXIT
assume_role() { local role_arn="${ROLE_ARN:-arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl}" local session_name="${ROLE_SESSION_NAME:-s3-test}" local duration="${ASSUME_DURATION_SECONDS:-3600}"
log "Assuming role ${role_arn} (duration=${duration}s)" local assume_json assume_json="$(mktemp)"
aws sts assume-role \ --duration-seconds "$duration" \ --role-arn "$role_arn" \ --role-session-name "$session_name" \ > "$assume_json"
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID="$(jq -r '.Credentials.AccessKeyId' "$assume_json")" AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SecretAccessKey' "$assume_json")" AWS_SESSION_TOKEN="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SessionToken' "$assume_json")" rm -f "$assume_json"
log "Role assumed" } reset_role() { unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID unset AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY unset AWS_SESSION_TOKEN unset AWS_SECURITY_TOKEN } reset_dir() { local d="$1" rm -rf "$d" mkdir -p "$d" }
s3_cp() { local src="$1" dst="$2" required="${3:-true}" if aws s3 cp "$src" "$dst" --no-progress --only-show-errors; then return 0 fi if [[ "$required" == "true" ]]; then error "S3 copy failed (required): $src -> $dst" return 1 fi warn "S3 copy failed (optional): $src -> $dst" return 0 }
# ----------------------------- # Prereqs + required inputs # ----------------------------- need aws need jq need csvcut need csvformat need tail need java
: "${managed_inputs:?managed_inputs must be set (s3://.../Managed_Inputs.csv)}"
S3_BUCKET="${S3_BUCKET:-avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl}" ASSUME_DURATION_SECONDS="${ASSUME_DURATION_SECONDS:-3600}"
# ----------------------------- # Workspace dirs (cleanly) # ----------------------------- reset_dir data reset_dir completed reset_dir completed_study_consents reset_dir hierarchies reset_dir processing reset_dir logs mkdir -p data/decoded mappings
# ----------------------------- # Assume role once for all S3 ops # ----------------------------- assume_role
# ----------------------------- # Pull core inputs # ----------------------------- log "Downloading managed inputs -> data/Managed_Inputs.csv" s3_cp "$managed_inputs" "data/Managed_Inputs.csv" true
log "Downloading Genomic_Managed_Inputs.csv" s3_cp "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/general/resources/Genomic_Managed_Inputs.csv" "data/Genomic_Managed_Inputs.csv" true
log "Downloading metadata.json" s3_cp "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/general/data/metadata.json" "data/metadata.json" true
log "Building inputs.csv" csvcut -c "Study Abbreviated Name","Study Identifier","Version","Study Type","Data is ready to process","Data Processed","Has Multi" \ "data/Managed_Inputs.csv" > inputs.csv
log "inputs.csv preview:" head -n 10 inputs.csv >&2 || true
# ----------------------------- # Per-study pulls # IMPORTANT FIX: # - Do NOT use a pipeline into `while read`; it runs in a subshell. # - If you background jobs inside that subshell, `wait` in the parent # will NOT wait for them. # # This version: # - Runs the loop in the current shell using process substitution (< <(...)) # - Tracks PIDs explicitly # - Waits for *all* PIDs and fails if any download failed # ----------------------------- DOWNLOAD_PARALLEL="${DOWNLOAD_PARALLEL:-12}" # Set DOWNLOAD_PARALLEL=1 to remove parallelism entirely. log "Downloading per-study multi assets with parallelism=${DOWNLOAD_PARALLEL}"
download_study_assets() { local abv_name="$1" stdy_id="$2" version="$3" local abv_lc stdy_lc abv_uc abv_lc="$(printf '%s' "$abv_name" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')" stdy_lc="$(printf '%s' "$stdy_id" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')" abv_uc="$(printf '%s' "$abv_name" | tr '[:lower:]' '[:upper:]')"
log "pulling data for ${abv_name} ${stdy_id}"
aws s3 cp "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/${abv_lc}/rawData/" "data/" \ --recursive --exclude "*" --no-progress \ --include "${stdy_id}*${version}*subject.multi*" --include "${stdy_id}*${version}*Subject.Multi*" --include "${stdy_id}*${version}*Subject.MULTI*" \ --include "${stdy_id}*${version}*sample.multi*" --include "${stdy_id}*${version}*Sample.Multi*" --include "${stdy_id}*${version}*Sample.MULTI*" \ || { error "rawData multi copy failed for ${abv_name} ${stdy_id}"; return 1; }
aws s3 cp "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/${abv_lc}/decoded_data/" "data/decoded/" \ --recursive --exclude "*" --no-progress \ --include "${stdy_id}*${version}*subject.multi*" --include "${stdy_id}*${version}*Subject.Multi*" --include "${stdy_id}*${version}*Subject.MULTI*" \ --include "${stdy_id}*${version}*sample.multi*" --include "${stdy_id}*${version}*Sample.Multi*" --include "${stdy_id}*${version}*Sample.MULTI*" \ || { error "decoded_data multi copy failed for ${abv_name} ${stdy_id}"; return 1; }
s3_cp "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/${abv_lc}/data/${abv_uc}_PatientMapping.v2.csv" "data/${abv_uc}_PatientMapping.v2.csv" true
aws s3 rm "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/general/globalvars/study_consents/" \ --recursive --exclude "*" --include "${abv_name}_${stdy_id}*" \ --only-show-errors \ || warn "Could not remove prior study_consents for ${abv_name} ${stdy_id} (may be none / permissions)"
# marker so we can verify completion count if we want : > "logs/download_ok_${stdy_lc}.marker"
log "done pulling ${abv_name} ${stdy_id}" }
# helper: block until active job count < DOWNLOAD_PARALLEL (uses wait -n if available) throttle() { while [[ "$(jobs -pr | wc -l)" -ge "$DOWNLOAD_PARALLEL" ]]; do if wait -n 2>/dev/null; then : else sleep 0.2 fi done }
declare -a DL_PIDS=() declare -i SCHEDULED=0
while IFS=',' read -r abv_name stdy_id version stdy_type data_ready data_processed has_multi; do # Trim possible quotes abv_name="${abv_name%\"}"; abv_name="${abv_name#\"}" stdy_id="${stdy_id%\"}"; stdy_id="${stdy_id#\"}" version="${version%\"}"; version="${version#\"}" data_ready="${data_ready%\"}"; data_ready="${data_ready#\"}" has_multi="${has_multi%\"}"; has_multi="${has_multi#\"}"
if [[ "${data_ready,,}" == "yes" ]] && [[ "${has_multi,,}" == "yes" ]]; then if [[ "$DOWNLOAD_PARALLEL" -le 1 ]]; then # fully serial mode download_study_assets "$abv_name" "$stdy_id" SCHEDULED+=1 else throttle download_study_assets "$abv_name" "$stdy_id" "$version" & DL_PIDS+=("$!") SCHEDULED+=1 log "scheduled ${abv_name} ${stdy_id} (pid=$!)" fi else log "${abv_name} ${stdy_id} not ready and/or has_multi!=yes; skipping" fi done < <(tail -n +2 inputs.csv | csvformat -U 1)
log "pulling harmonized data set" s3_cp "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/hrmn/completed/HRMN_allConcepts.csv" "data/HRMN_allConcepts.csv" true
# Wait for downloads and *fail if any failed* if [[ "${#DL_PIDS[@]}" -gt 0 ]]; then log "Waiting for ${#DL_PIDS[@]} per-study downloads to finish..." failed=0 for pid in "${DL_PIDS[@]}"; do if ! wait "$pid"; then failed=1 error "Download worker failed (pid=$pid)" fi done if [[ "$failed" -ne 0 ]]; then error "One or more per-study downloads failed" exit 1 fi fi
# Optional sanity check: markers count equals scheduled count markers="$(ls -1 logs/download_ok_*.marker 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" if [[ "$markers" -ne "$SCHEDULED" ]]; then error "Download completion mismatch: scheduled=$SCHEDULED markers=$markers" exit 1 fi
log "All downloads complete"
# ----------------------------- # Run generators # ----------------------------- export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/temurin-24-jdk-amd64 export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
log "generating consent group data" java -jar jars/entity-generator-1.0.0-SNAPSHOT-ConsentGroupGenerator.jar 2>> logs/error_logging.txt
log "generating phs id data" java -jar jars/entity-generator-1.0.0-SNAPSHOT-PHSIdGenerator.jar 2>> logs/error_logging.txt
log "generating rootnode data" java -jar jars/entity-generator-1.0.0-SNAPSHOT-RootNodeGenerator.jar 2>> logs/error_logging.txt
log "generating genomic sample id global var data" java -jar jars/entity-generator-1.0.0-SNAPSHOT-GenomicSampIdGlobalVarGenerator.jar 2>> logs/error_logging.txt
log "generating studies consents" java -jar jars/entity-generator-1.0.0-SNAPSHOT-StudiesConsentsGenerator.jar -writedir ./completed_study_consents/ 2>> logs/error_logging.txt
if [[ -s logs/error_logging.txt ]]; then warn "Errors were logged during generation (see logs/error_logging.txt). Proceeding to upload outputs." fi
# ----------------------------- # Upload outputs + update mapping # ----------------------------- reset_role assume_role log "Uploading completed/ -> s3://${S3_BUCKET}/general/data/" aws s3 cp "completed/" "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/general/data/" --recursive --no-progress --only-show-errors
log "Downloading baseline mapping.prerootnodes.csv -> mappings/mapping.csv" s3_cp "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/general/mappings/mapping.prerootnodes.csv" "mappings/mapping.csv" true
if [[ -s "completed/SampleId_mapping.csv" ]]; then log "Appending SampleId_mapping.csv -> mappings/mapping.csv" cat "completed/SampleId_mapping.csv" >> "mappings/mapping.csv" else warn "completed/SampleId_mapping.csv missing/empty; skipping append" fi
if [[ -s "completed/rootnode_mapping.csv" ]]; then log "Appending rootnode_mapping.csv -> mappings/mapping.csv" cat "completed/rootnode_mapping.csv" >> "mappings/mapping.csv" else warn "completed/rootnode_mapping.csv missing/empty; skipping append" fi
log "Uploading mapping.postrootnodes.csv" aws s3 cp "mappings/mapping.csv" "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/general/mappings/mapping.postrootnodes.csv" --no-progress --only-show-errors
log "Uploading completed_study_consents/ -> s3://${S3_BUCKET}/general/globalvars/study_consents/" aws s3 cp "completed_study_consents/" "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/general/globalvars/study_consents/" --recursive --no-progress --only-show-errors
log "Done"
